definitions.explanation: A rod or line around which something rotates, or a central line used as a reference in geometry or graphs.
The central element or guiding principle around which other things are organized.
A mounted calligraphy or painting scroll, short for {掛け軸|かけじく}.

examples.japanese: ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧X{軸|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please look at the X-axis of the graph.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車輪|しゃりん}→車輪：04198_sharin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軸|じく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれている→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軸|じく}にして⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: This map is drawn with the east-west direction as its axis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{軸|じく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}した→議論する：06058_gironsuru⟧。
examples.english: We discussed the issue with environmental concerns as the central focus.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軸|じく}になっている。
examples.english: She is the backbone of the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧とした{軸|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to have a firm core within yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{軸|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}ける。
examples.english: To hang a scroll in the tokonoma alcove.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{軸|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}えている→替える：13399_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I change the hanging scroll to match the season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軸|じく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家宝|かほう}→家宝：17734_kahou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A calligraphy scroll written by my grandfather is carefully kept as a family heirloom.

notes:
A versatile word used across mechanical, abstract, and traditional arts contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- X{軸|じく}・Y{軸|じく} (X-axis, Y-axis)
- {軸|じく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぶれる→ぶれる：10522_bureru⟧ (to lose one's focus/direction)
- {軸|じく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have a core/backbone)
- ⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧ (hanging scroll)

Sense 2 is especially common in self-help and business language, where having a {軸|じく} means having clear principles. Not to be confused with ⟦{字句|じく}→字句：12254_jiku⟧ (wording, phrasing), which is a homophone.
